name: Title Logo Colors
description: Recolours the small "SUPER MARIO" line of the title-screen logo (a red / yellow / green pattern). Only the per-cell colour field changes — the glyphs stay put. Edit the palette digit in each `($0X<<10)` line of the sibling .asm to recolour (0 = green, 2 = red, 3 = yellow).
details: asm patch: in-place overwrite of the BG2 tilemap words for rows 2 & 3, cols 4..14 of DATA_title_screen_logo_tilemap ($0F:FC80, DMA'd to VRAM $3E40). Each word = $2000 (BG priority) | char# | (palette << 10); only the 3-bit palette field is changed per cell. Anchored via the !DATA_title_screen_logo_tilemap define (row 2 = base+$88, row 3 = base+$C8) so the writes track asm drift instead of a raw org. The logo sub-palettes expose only three usable fill colours: 0 green, 2 red, 3 yellow; field 1 / >3 pull the white "Yoshi's Island" sub-palette.
